plan.title: Awaiting Merge: hide projects with nothing ready instead of repeating 'No features are ready to merge' for each
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The Awaiting Merge page renders a section for every registered project, so eight idle projects each repeat the identical 'No features are ready to merge' boilerplate, burying the sections that carry real information.
narratives.Proposal: Add an isIdleSection predicate and a renderedSections filter in MergeTrainView.tsx: idle ENABLED sections are not rendered; disabled ('merge train off') sections always render; when the filter leaves nothing, the page falls through to the existing page-level empty state (with 'Loading the merge train…' during fetch); a quiet footer counts the hidden idle projects. The anyDisabled/nothingAnywhere guard is replaced by this filter (same invariant, encoded structurally), the now-unreachable per-section idle boilerplate branch is removed, and the MergeTrainView tests are updated/extended to anchor the new behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the project filter chips row, its localStorage persistence, or its copy
- No change to mergeTrainTotals, useMergeTrainData, or the Flywheel rail card (MergeQueueCard.tsx) counts
- No change to the page-level empty copy text or the disabled-section off-copy text
- No change to visibleGenerationsOf or generation status handling
- No server routes, API payloads, or config changes

autoDecisions.summary: Include the optional footer line 'N projects with nothing ready are hidden'.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue marks the footer optional but recommends it ('keeps the page honest about what it is not showing'); it costs two lines of JSX and one test assertion.

autoDecisions.summary: Replace the anyDisabled/nothingAnywhere collapse guard with the renderedSections filter rather than keeping both.
autoDecisions.rationale: Two JSX branches with identical copy would be redundant; the filter encodes the same invariant structurally (any disabled row keeps renderedSections non-empty), and the existing all-disabled and mixed tests cover the equivalence.

autoDecisions.summary: When the project-filter chips select only idle enabled projects, render the page-level 'No features are ready to merge in any project' copy.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's point 3 explicitly requires falling through to the existing page-level empty state so the page is never blank.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the project filter chips listing every project, idle or not.
autoDecisions.rationale: The chips are the operator's selection tool; hiding idle projects from them would make an idle project unselectable and contradict the chip-edge fall-through decision.

items.title: Hide idle enabled sections in MergeTrainView via a renderedSections filter

expected_outputs: MergeTrainView.test.tsx suite exits 0 once the companion test item lands

narrative.Action: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/merge-train/MergeTrainView.tsx: (1) After visibleGenerationsOf (line 156), add `function isIdleSection(section: MergeTrainProjectSection): boolean { return section.queue.length === 0 && visibleGenerationsOf(section).length === 0; }`. (2) After visibleSections (line 267), add `const renderedSections = visibleSections.filter((s) => !s.enabled || !isIdleSection(s));` and `const idleHiddenCount = visibleSections.length - renderedSections.length;`, with a comment stating: idle enabled sections are hidden because the repeated boilerplate is noise; disabled sections are NEVER idle-hidden because 'merge train off' is information, not emptiness. (3) Delete the anyDisabled/nothingAnywhere block (lines 427-438). (4) Restructure the JSX conditional (lines 479-493) to: sections.length === 0 → existing loading/no-projects copy; visibleSections.length === 0 → existing chip-filter copy; renderedSections.length === 0 → `loading ? 'Loading the merge train…' : <existing page-level 'No features are ready to merge in any project. …' copy verbatim>`; otherwise map renderedSections. (5) In the section body, remove the now-unreachable `featureCount === 0 && visibleGenerations.length === 0` boilerplate branch (lines 523-526) so the ternary is `!section.enabled ? off-copy : content`; keep the off-copy verbatim. Full before/after snippets are in the PRD at .pan/drafts/PAN-3158.md §Proposal.
